svg.title: Equivariant discrete decomposition and inner absorption
svg.desc: The return crossing K equals N zero crossed by chi zero. An equivariant stable isomorphism F maps it to M tensor B of H star. Absorption maps this algebra to M and changes alpha zero tensor identity to Ad z composed with alpha zero. The dual weight has centralizer N and a modular spectral gap.
